title: Interaction between MICO mode with active time and extended idle mode DRX cycle

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that can request MICO mode with active time and eDRX during registration.

entities.name: MICO mode with active time
entities.description: A power saving mode where the UE remains reachable for a certain active time period after registration.

entities.name: Extended idle mode DRX cycle
entities.description: Extended Discontinuous Reception cycle that allows longer sleep periods for the UE to save power.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which the UE can request MICO mode with active time and eDRX.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that decides whether to enable MICO mode with active time, eDRX, both, or none.

entities.name: Extended DRX parameters
entities.description: Parameters provided to the UE when both MICO mode with active time and eDRX are accepted, configured to allow multiple paging occasions before active timer expires.

entities.name: Active timer
entities.description: Timer that defines the active time period in MICO mode during which the UE is reachable.

entities.name: Paging occasions
entities.description: Time instances when the network can page the UE, which should occur multiple times before the active timer expires when both MICO mode with active time and eDRX are enabled.

relations.description: UE requests MICO mode with active time and eDRX during registration procedure.
Registration procedure can include request for MICO mode with active time.
Registration procedure can include request for extended idle mode DRX cycle.
Network decides whether to enable MICO mode with active time.
Network decides whether to enable extended idle mode DRX cycle.
Network provides extended DRX parameters to the UE when both MICO mode with active time and eDRX are accepted.
Extended DRX parameters should allow for multiple paging occasions before active timer expires.
Multiple paging occasions should occur before the active timer expires.
